title: Tropical and community-acquired AKI

steps.tx: Envenomation by the **Russell viper** (**Daboia russelii**) induces profound venom-induced consumption coagulopathy (**VICC**), widespread capillary leak, acute tubular necrosis, and catastrophic renal **cortical necrosis**. Direct venom metalloproteinases, phospholipases, and procoagulant toxins trigger systemic microvascular thrombosis and direct tubular epithelial cytotoxicity, requiring immediate antivenom administration and hemodynamic resuscitation.

steps.tx: Envenomation by the **Hump-nosed pit viper** (**Hypnale hypnale**) represents an underrecognized cause of severe AKI and acute renal cortical necrosis across Sri Lanka and peninsular India. Clinical presentation features venom-induced coagulopathy characterized by an unclotted **20-minute whole blood clotting time** despite normal prothrombin and partial thromboplastin times, remaining entirely unneutralized by standard polyvalent antivenom.

right.title: Daboia russelii Envenomation

steps.tx: Severe **Leptospirosis** (**Weil disease**) provokes intense tubulointerstitial nephritis and tubular necrosis classically manifesting as unique **hypokalemic**, non-oliguric acute kidney injury. Patients exhibit marked **conjunctival suffusion**, profound conjugated jaundice, deep calf myalgias, and severe thrombocytopenia, where cellular sodium-potassium ATPase downregulation drives excessive urinary potassium and magnesium wasting.

left.title: Weil Disease Renal Hallmarks
points: Responsive to intravenous penicillin or ceftriaxone

steps.tx: Severe **Falciparum malaria** triggers fulminant **blackwater fever** and acute kidney injury through massive intravascular hemolysis, systemic microvascular cytoadherence of parasitized erythrocytes, and intratubular **cast nephropathy**. Prompt initiation of intravenous artesunate therapy halts parasite proliferation, while aggressive crystalloid hydration prevents obstructive heme cast precipitation within vulnerable distal nephrons.

steps.tx: Tick-borne **Scrub typhus** caused by **Orientia tsutsugamushi** manifests clinically with a diagnostic pathognomonic cutaneous **eschar**, high remittent fever, generalized lymphadenopathy, and acute kidney injury mediated by disseminated endothelial vasculitis. Timely recognition and oral or intravenous administration of **doxycycline** or azithromycin produces dramatic clinical defervescence and prompt reversal of renal impairment.

steps.tx: Bilateral **cortical necrosis** represents an irreversible ischemic catastrophe accounting for **5%** to **10%** of tropical acute kidney injury admissions. Predominantly precipitated by catastrophic **abruptio placentae**, septic puerperal abortion, or venomous snakebites, contrast-enhanced CT demonstrates non-enhancing necrotic renal cortex surrounded by a characteristic rim of preserved subcapsular collateral enhancement.

points: Triggered by abruptio placentae and snakebite
CT shows rim of subcapsular enhancement

right.title: Acute Tubular Necrosis
points: High likelihood of complete renal recovery

steps.tx: Rodent-borne **Hantavirus infection** presenting as hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (**HFRS**) is triggered by Dobrava, Hantaan, or **Puumala viruses**. Pathophysiology centers on severe capillary hyperpermeability, marked thrombocytopenia, retroperitoneal edema, and acute oliguric **tubulointerstitial nephritis**, often accompanied by conjunctival hemorrhages and transient anterior pituitary insufficiency.

steps.tx: Community-acquired diarrheal **STEC-HUS** develops following enteric infection with **Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli** serotype **O157:H7** in children and adults. Circulating Shiga toxins bind microvascular globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) receptors, producing the classical diagnostic triad of microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, severe peripheral **thrombocytopenia**, and acute oliguric renal failure.
